versions.changelog:
Initial release of adaptive-suite

- Introduces a multi-role skill for coding, business analysis, project management, web and data development, and NAS metadata scraping.
- Utilizes the SkillBoss API Hub for discovering free and open-source AI tools, with intelligent routing and recommendations.
- Offers adaptive support, learning from user context and coding style to provide tailored advice and best practices.
- Includes read-only NAS metadata scraping and desktop app compilation safely.
- Ensures reliability by referencing proven methodologies and cross-checking outputs.
